description: Programming and software development prompts ranging from basic coding tasks to complex system implementations

prompts.title: Function Implementation
prompts.prompt: Write a function in [language] that [functionality description]. Include input parameters, return type, and handle edge cases appropriately.

prompts.title: Algorithm Explanation
prompts.prompt: Explain the [algorithm name] algorithm step by step. Provide a code implementation in [language] with comments explaining each part.

prompts.title: Code Debugging
prompts.prompt: Debug the following code and explain what's wrong: [code snippet]. Provide the corrected version with explanations for each fix.

prompts.title: Code Refactoring
prompts.prompt: Refactor the following code to improve readability, performance, and maintainability: [code snippet]. Explain the changes made and why they improve the code.

prompts.title: API Design
prompts.prompt: Design a RESTful API for [system description]. Include: endpoints, request/response formats, authentication method, error handling, and example requests.

prompts.title: Database Schema Design
prompts.prompt: Design a database schema for [application description]. Include: entity-relationship diagram description, table structures, relationships, indexes, and normalization considerations.

prompts.title: Unit Test Writing
prompts.prompt: Write comprehensive unit tests for the following function: [function code]. Include test cases for normal inputs, edge cases, and error conditions using [testing framework].

prompts.title: Code Review Request
prompts.prompt: Review the following code for best practices, potential bugs, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues: [code snippet]. Provide specific recommendations with explanations.

prompts.title: Design Pattern Implementation
prompts.prompt: Implement the [design pattern name] pattern in [language] for [use case scenario]. Explain when this pattern is appropriate and its benefits.

prompts.title: SQL Query Optimization
prompts.prompt: Optimize the following SQL query for better performance: [query]. Explain the performance issues and how your optimization addresses them.

prompts.title: Frontend Component
prompts.prompt: Create a [framework] component for [component description]. Include: component structure, props definition, state management, styling, and example usage.

prompts.title: Error Handling Strategy
prompts.prompt: Design an error handling strategy for [application type] in [language]. Include: error types, error propagation, logging approach, user-facing error messages, and recovery mechanisms.

prompts.title: CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
prompts.prompt: Create a CI/CD pipeline configuration for [project type] using [CI/CD tool]. Include: build stages, testing steps, deployment strategy, and environment configurations.

prompts.title: Regular Expression
prompts.prompt: Write a regular expression to match [pattern description]. Explain how the regex works and provide examples of strings that match and don't match.

prompts.title: Microservice Design
prompts.prompt: Design a microservice architecture for [system description]. Include: service boundaries, communication patterns, data management, fault tolerance, and scalability considerations.

prompts.title: GraphQL Schema
prompts.prompt: Design a GraphQL schema for [application description]. Include: types, queries, mutations, subscriptions, and resolvers structure.

prompts.title: Security Audit Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create a security audit checklist for [application type]. Include: authentication, authorization, input validation, data protection, and common vulnerability checks.

prompts.title: Performance Optimization
prompts.prompt: Analyze and optimize the performance of the following code/application: [code/description]. Identify bottlenecks and provide specific optimization techniques.

prompts.title: Technical Documentation
prompts.prompt: Write technical documentation for the following code/API: [code/description]. Include: overview, installation, usage examples, API reference, and troubleshooting guide.

prompts.title: Code Translation
prompts.prompt: Translate the following code from [source language] to [target language]. Maintain the same functionality and adapt to the target language's idioms and best practices.
